ddlStatements.sql: ALTER TABLE naijue_erp.hall ADD FOREIGN KEY (default_sales_warehouse_id) REFERENCES naijue_erp.warehouse(id);
CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.size_group (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, code text NOT NULL UNIQUE, name text NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.season (id uuid PRIMARY KEY, code text NOT NULL UNIQUE, name text NOT NULL, display_order integer NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.sales_header (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, number text NOT NULL CHECK (length(number) > 0),
  business_type text NOT NULL CHECK (business_type IN ('SALE', 'RETURN', 'EXCHANGE')), business_date date NOT NULL,
  hall_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.hall(id), salesperson_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.staff(id),
  customer_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.customer(id), warehouse_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.warehouse(id),
  status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVED', 'VOID')), gross_amount decimal(18,2) NOT NULL,
  order_discount decimal(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (order_discount >= 0), net_due decimal(18,2) NOT NULL, note text,
  version integer NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0), created_by_account_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.user_account(id),
  created_hall_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.hall(id), created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  approved_by_account_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.user_account(id), approved_at timestamptz,
  stock_basis text NOT NULL CHECK (stock_basis IN ('RUNTIME_LEDGER', 'CUTOFF_HISTORY')),
  CHECK ((status = 'APPROVED' AND approved_by_account_id IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)
    OR (status <> 'APPROVED' AND approved_by_account_id IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL))
  
  
);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.sales_line (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, sales_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.sales_header(id), line_no integer NOT NULL CHECK (line_no > 0),
  sku_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.sku(id), quantity bigint NOT NULL,
  reference_price decimal(18,2) CHECK (reference_price >= 0), deal_price decimal(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (deal_price >= 0),
  line_amount decimal(18,2) NOT NULL, allocated_discount decimal(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (allocated_discount >= 0), is_gift boolean NOT NULL,
  product_code_snapshot text NOT NULL, product_name_snapshot text NOT NULL, color_name_snapshot text NOT NULL,
  fit_name_snapshot text NOT NULL, size_name_snapshot text NOT NULL, barcode_snapshot text, is_current boolean NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.operation_receipt (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, actor_account_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.user_account(id),
  request_key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(request_key) > 0), request_hash text NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('SAVE', 'APPROVE', 'UNAPPROVE', 'VOID')),
  target_type text NOT NULL CHECK (target_type = 'SALES'), target_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.sales_header(id),
  status text NOT NULL CHECK (status = 'COMMITTED'), result_data jsonb NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT transaction_timestamp(), completed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (actor_account_id, request_key), UNIQUE (id, actor_account_id, target_id, action),
  CHECK (jsonb_typeof(result_data) = 'object' AND result_data ?& ARRAY['operationId', 'salesId', 'version', 'status', 'ledgerEntryIds']
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'operationId') = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'salesId') = 'string'
    AND (result_data->>'operationId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM id::text
    AND (result_data->>'salesId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM target_id::text
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'version') = 'number' AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'status') = 'string'
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'ledgerEntryIds') = 'array')
);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.audit_change (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, operation_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE, actor_account_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.user_account(id),
  object_type text NOT NULL CHECK (object_type = 'SALES'), object_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.sales_header(id),
  action text NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('SAVE', 'APPROVE', 'UNAPPROVE', 'VOID')),
  old_version integer CHECK (old_version > 0), new_version integer NOT NULL CHECK (new_version > 0),
  before_values jsonb, after_values jsonb NOT NULL, occurred_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (operation_id, object_id), CHECK (new_version = COALESCE(old_version, 0) + 1),
  FOREIGN KEY (operation_id, actor_account_id, object_id, action)
    REFERENCES naijue_erp.operation_receipt (id, actor_account_id, target_id, action) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
);

ALTER TABLE naijue_erp.operation_receipt ADD CONSTRAINT receipt_requires_audit
  FOREIGN KEY (id, target_id) REFERENCES naijue_erp.audit_change (operation_id, object_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.inventory_ledger (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, operation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.operation_receipt(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  event_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (event_kind IN ('APPROVE', 'UNAPPROVE')), warehouse_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.warehouse(id),
  sku_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.sku(id), quantity_delta bigint NOT NULL CHECK (quantity_delta <> 0),
  source_sales_line_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.sales_line(id), endpoint text NOT NULL CHECK (endpoint = 'SALES_WAREHOUSE'),
  source_document_version integer NOT NULL CHECK (source_document_version > 0),
  reverses_entry_id uuid UNIQUE REFERENCES naijue_erp.inventory_ledger(id), business_date date NOT NULL, posted_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (operation_id, source_sales_line_id, endpoint),
  CHECK ((event_kind = 'UNAPPROVE') = (reverses_entry_id IS NOT NULL))
);

ALTER TABLE naijue_erp.sales_line
  ADD COLUMN pricing_rule text,
  ADD COLUMN discount_tenths integer,
  ADD COLUMN zero_confirmed boolean;

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.auth_session (
  token_hash text PRIMARY KEY CHECK (token_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  account_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.user_account(id),
  auth_version integer NOT NULL CHECK (auth_version > 0),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  expires_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.transfer_header (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, number text NOT NULL CHECK (length(number) > 0), business_date date NOT NULL,
  from_warehouse_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.warehouse(id),
  to_warehouse_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.warehouse(id),
  status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVED', 'VOID')), version integer NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0), note text,
  created_by_account_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.user_account(id), created_hall_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.hall(id),
  created_role text NOT NULL CHECK (created_role IN ('ADMIN', 'WAREHOUSE', 'SALESPERSON')),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  approved_by_account_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.user_account(id), approved_at timestamptz,
  stock_basis text NOT NULL CHECK (stock_basis IN ('RUNTIME_LEDGER', 'CUTOFF_HISTORY')),
  CHECK (from_warehouse_id <> to_warehouse_id),
  CHECK ((status = 'APPROVED' AND approved_by_account_id IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL)
    OR (status <> 'APPROVED' AND approved_by_account_id IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.transfer_line (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, transfer_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.transfer_header(id),
  line_no integer NOT NULL CHECK (line_no > 0), sku_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.sku(id),
  quantity bigint NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
  product_code_snapshot text NOT NULL, product_name_snapshot text NOT NULL, color_name_snapshot text NOT NULL,
  fit_name_snapshot text NOT NULL, size_name_snapshot text NOT NULL, barcode_snapshot text, is_current boolean NOT NULL,
  
  current_line_no integer GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN is_current THEN line_no END) STORED,
  CONSTRAINT transfer_line_current_position UNIQUE (transfer_id, current_line_no) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
);

ALTER TABLE naijue_erp.operation_receipt
  DROP CONSTRAINT operation_receipt_target_type_check,
  DROP CONSTRAINT operation_receipt_target_id_fkey,
  ADD CONSTRAINT receipt_target_kind CHECK (target_type IN ('SALES', 'TRANSFER')),
  ADD COLUMN target_sales_id uuid GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN target_type = 'SALES' THEN target_id END) STORED REFERENCES naijue_erp.sales_header(id),
  ADD COLUMN target_transfer_id uuid GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN target_type = 'TRANSFER' THEN target_id END) STORED REFERENCES naijue_erp.transfer_header(id),
  ADD CONSTRAINT receipt_kind_identity UNIQUE (id, actor_account_id, target_type, target_id, action);

ALTER TABLE naijue_erp.audit_change
  DROP CONSTRAINT audit_change_object_type_check,
  DROP CONSTRAINT audit_change_object_id_fkey,
  ADD CONSTRAINT audit_object_kind CHECK (object_type IN ('SALES', 'TRANSFER')),
  ADD COLUMN object_sales_id uuid GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN object_type = 'SALES' THEN object_id END) STORED REFERENCES naijue_erp.sales_header(id),
  ADD COLUMN object_transfer_id uuid GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN object_type = 'TRANSFER' THEN object_id END) STORED REFERENCES naijue_erp.transfer_header(id),
  ADD CONSTRAINT audit_kind_identity UNIQUE (operation_id, object_type, object_id),
  ADD CONSTRAINT audit_receipt_kind_coherence FOREIGN KEY (operation_id, actor_account_id, object_type, object_id, action)
    REFERENCES naijue_erp.operation_receipt (id, actor_account_id, target_type, target_id, action) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;

ALTER TABLE naijue_erp.operation_receipt ADD CONSTRAINT receipt_requires_same_kind_audit
  FOREIGN KEY (id, target_type, target_id) REFERENCES naijue_erp.audit_change (operation_id, object_type, object_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED;

ALTER TABLE naijue_erp.operation_receipt ADD CONSTRAINT receipt_result_by_kind CHECK (
  jsonb_typeof(result_data) = 'object' AND result_data ?& ARRAY['operationId', 'version', 'status', 'ledgerEntryIds']
  AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'operationId') = 'string'
  AND (result_data->>'operationId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM id::text
  AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'version') = 'number' AND result_data->>'version' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
  AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'status') = 'string' AND result_data->>'status' IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVED', 'VOID')
  AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'ledgerEntryIds') = 'array'
  AND CASE target_type
    WHEN 'SALES' THEN result_data ? 'salesId' AND NOT (result_data ? 'transferId')
      AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'salesId') = 'string' AND (result_data->>'salesId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM target_id::text
    WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN result_data ? 'transferId' AND NOT (result_data ? 'salesId')
      AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'transferId') = 'string' AND (result_data->>'transferId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM target_id::text
    ELSE false END
);

ALTER TABLE naijue_erp.inventory_ledger
  ALTER COLUMN source_sales_line_id DROP NOT NULL,
  ADD COLUMN source_transfer_line_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.transfer_line(id),
  DROP CONSTRAINT inventory_ledger_endpoint_check,
  ADD CONSTRAINT ledger_exactly_one_native_source CHECK (
    (source_sales_line_id IS NOT NULL AND source_transfer_line_id IS NULL AND endpoint = 'SALES_WAREHOUSE')
    OR (source_sales_line_id IS NULL AND source_transfer_line_id IS NOT NULL AND endpoint IN ('FROM', 'TO'))

  ADD CONSTRAINT ledger_transfer_operation_endpoint UNIQUE (operation_id, source_transfer_line_id, endpoint);

  version integer NOT NULL CHECK (version > 0)

  ADD CONSTRAINT receipt_action_by_kind CHECK (
    (target_type IN ('SALES', 'TRANSFER') AND action IN ('SAVE', 'APPROVE', 'UNAPPROVE', 'VOID'))

    (object_type IN ('SALES', 'TRANSFER') AND action IN ('SAVE', 'APPROVE', 'UNAPPROVE', 'VOID'))
    OR (object_type IN ('CUSTOMER', 'SUPPLIER') AND action IN ('CREATE', 'EDIT', 'DISABLE', 'RESTORE'))),

  jsonb_typeof(result_data) = 'object'
  AND CASE WHEN target_type IN ('SALES', 'TRANSFER') THEN
    result_data ?& ARRAY['operationId', 'version', 'status', 'ledgerEntryIds']
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'operationId') = 'string' AND (result_data->>'operationId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM id::text
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'version') = 'number' AND result_data->>'version' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'status') = 'string' AND result_data->>'status' IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVED', 'VOID')
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'ledgerEntryIds') = 'array'
    AND CASE target_type
      WHEN 'SALES' THEN result_data ? 'salesId' AND NOT (result_data ? 'transferId')
        AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'salesId') = 'string' AND (result_data->>'salesId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM target_id::text
      WHEN 'TRANSFER' THEN result_data ? 'transferId' AND NOT (result_data ? 'salesId')
        AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'transferId') = 'string' AND (result_data->>'transferId') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM target_id::text
      ELSE false END
  ELSE
    result_data ?& ARRAY['operationId', 'kind', 'partyId', 'version', 'code', 'enabled']
    AND (result_data - ARRAY['operationId', 'kind', 'partyId', 'version', 'code', 'enabled']) = '{}'::jsonb
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'operationId') = 'string' AND result_data->>'operationId' = id::text
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'kind') = 'string' AND result_data->>'kind' = target_type
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'partyId') = 'string' AND result_data->>'partyId' = target_id::text
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'version') = 'number' AND result_data->>'version' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'code') = 'string' AND length(btrim(result_data->>'code')) > 0
    AND jsonb_typeof(result_data->'enabled') = 'boolean'
  END
) IS TRUE);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.import_batch (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, source_name text NOT NULL CHECK (source_name ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_.:-]*$'),
  source_manifest_ref text NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(source_manifest_ref)) > 0),
  source_hash text NOT NULL CHECK (source_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'), cutoff_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  mapping_version text NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(mapping_version)) > 0),
  inventory_mode text NOT NULL CHECK (inventory_mode = 'CUTOFF_STOCK_BASELINE'),
  status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('STAGED', 'VALIDATING', 'PASSED', 'IMPORTED', 'FAILED')),
  checkpoint jsonb NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL, completed_at timestamptz,
  CHECK ((status = 'IMPORTED') = (completed_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(checkpoint) = 'object' AND checkpoint ?& ARRAY['sequence', 'cursor', 'counts', 'expected']
    AND (checkpoint - ARRAY['sequence', 'cursor', 'counts', 'expected']) = '{}'::jsonb
    AND checkpoint->>'sequence' ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND checkpoint->>'cursor' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND jsonb_typeof(checkpoint->'counts') = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(checkpoint->'expected') = 'object') IS TRUE)
);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.import_record (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY, import_batch_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.import_batch(id),

  source_key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(source_key) > 0),
  source_record_hash text NOT NULL CHECK (source_record_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  source_file_ref text NOT NULL CHECK (length(btrim(source_file_ref)) > 0),
  target_type text CHECK (target_type IN ('WAREHOUSE', 'SKU', 'INVENTORY_LEDGER', 'IMPORT_BATCH')),
  target_id uuid, status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('ACCEPTED', 'QUARANTINED', 'EXCLUDED', 'CONFLICT', 'IMPORTED')),
  decision_reason text, reviewed_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (import_batch_id, source_entity_type, source_key),
  CHECK ((target_type IS NULL) = (target_id IS NULL)),
  CHECK (status <> 'IMPORTED' OR (target_type IS NOT NULL AND reviewed_at IS NOT NULL))
);

  size_group_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.size_group(id), season_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.season(id),

  validator_version text NOT NULL CHECK (validator_version='NATIVE_CATALOGUE_IMPORT_V1'),

  UNIQUE (batch_id,category_id), UNIQUE (batch_id,color_id), UNIQUE (batch_id,fit_id), UNIQUE (batch_id,size_id),

  CHECK ((entity_type='CATEGORY' AND category_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(category_id,color_id,fit_id,size_id,size_group_id,season_id,member_group_id,member_size_id)=1)
    OR (entity_type='COLOR' AND color_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(category_id,color_id,fit_id,size_id,size_group_id,season_id,member_group_id,member_size_id)=1)
    OR (entity_type='FIT' AND fit_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(category_id,color_id,fit_id,size_id,size_group_id,season_id,member_group_id,member_size_id)=1)
    OR (entity_type='SIZE' AND size_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(category_id,color_id,fit_id,size_id,size_group_id,season_id,member_group_id,member_size_id)=1)
    OR (entity_type='SIZE_GROUP' AND size_group_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(category_id,color_id,fit_id,size_id,size_group_id,season_id,member_group_id,member_size_id)=1)
    OR (entity_type='SEASON' AND season_id IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(category_id,color_id,fit_id,size_id,size_group_id,season_id,member_group_id,member_size_id)=1)
    OR (entity_type='SIZE_GROUP_MEMBER' AND member_group_id IS NOT NULL AND member_size_id IS NOT NULL
      AND num_nonnulls(category_id,color_id,fit_id,size_id,size_group_id,season_id,member_group_id,member_size_id)=2))
);

ALTER TABLE naijue_erp.import_record ADD CONSTRAINT import_record_accounting_identity
  UNIQUE (import_batch_id,id,target_type,target_id);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.import_record_accounting_claim (
  import_batch_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.import_batch(id), import_record_id uuid NOT NULL,
  target_type text NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('WAREHOUSE','SKU','INVENTORY_LEDGER','IMPORT_BATCH')),
  target_id uuid NOT NULL, operation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.operation_receipt(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
  checkpoint_sequence integer NOT NULL CHECK (checkpoint_sequence > 0 AND checkpoint_sequence < 2147483646),
  claimed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  validator_version text NOT NULL CHECK (validator_version='NATIVE_IMPORT_RECORD_ACCOUNTING_V1'),
  PRIMARY KEY (import_batch_id,import_record_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (import_batch_id,import_record_id,target_type,target_id)
    REFERENCES naijue_erp.import_record(import_batch_id,id,target_type,target_id)
);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.import_native_payment_binding (
  batch_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.import_batch(id),
  entity_type text NOT NULL CHECK(entity_type IN ('PAYMENT_METHOD','PAYMENT_ACCOUNT','PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_HALL')),
  source_key text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(source_key))>0), source_row_id uuid NOT NULL,
  native_payment_method_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.payment_method(id),
  native_payment_account_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.payment_account(id), native_hall_id uuid REFERENCES naijue_erp.hall(id),
  native_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(native_snapshot)='object'),
  evidence_fingerprint text NOT NULL CHECK(evidence_fingerprint ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  validator_version text NOT NULL CHECK(validator_version='NATIVE_PAYMENT_IMPORT_V1'),
  PRIMARY KEY(batch_id,entity_type,source_key), UNIQUE(batch_id,source_row_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(batch_id,source_row_id) REFERENCES naijue_erp.import_source_row(batch_id,id),
  CHECK((entity_type='PAYMENT_METHOD' AND native_payment_method_id IS NOT NULL AND native_payment_account_id IS NULL AND native_hall_id IS NULL)
    OR (entity_type='PAYMENT_ACCOUNT' AND native_payment_method_id IS NOT NULL AND native_payment_account_id IS NOT NULL AND native_hall_id IS NULL)
    OR (entity_type='PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_HALL' AND native_payment_method_id IS NULL AND native_payment_account_id IS NOT NULL AND native_hall_id IS NOT NULL))
);

ALTER TABLE naijue_erp.import_native_payment_binding ADD CONSTRAINT native_payment_relation_fk
  FOREIGN KEY(native_payment_account_id,native_hall_id) REFERENCES naijue_erp.payment_account_hall(payment_account_id,hall_id);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.import_history_closure_manifest (
 batch_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES naijue_erp.import_batch(id),
 validator_version text NOT NULL CHECK(validator_version='HISTORY_TYPED_CLOSURE_V1'),
 selection_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(selection_sha256~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 authorized_payload_hash text NOT NULL CHECK(authorized_payload_hash~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 source_manifest_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(source_manifest_sha256~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 typed_manifest_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(typed_manifest_sha256~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 document_manifest_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(document_manifest_sha256~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 expected_counts jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(naijue_erp.history_closure_count_map(expected_counts,ARRAY['history_sales_header','history_sales_line','history_sales_settlement','history_transfer_header','history_transfer_line','import_source_row','import_sku_alias','import_stock_contributor','barcodes'])),
 source_entity_counts jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(naijue_erp.history_closure_count_map(source_entity_counts,ARRAY['HALL','WAREHOUSE','STAFF','CUSTOMER','SUPPLIER','CATEGORY','COLOR','FIT','SIZE','SIZE_GROUP','SIZE_GROUP_MEMBER','SEASON','PRODUCT','SKU','BARCODE','INVENTORY_BASELINE','PAYMENT_METHOD','PAYMENT_ACCOUNT','PAYMENT_ACCOUNT_HALL','SALES_HEADER','SALES_LINE','SETTLEMENT','TRANSFER_HEADER','TRANSFER_LINE'])),
 document_count integer NOT NULL CHECK(document_count BETWEEN 0 AND 100000)
);

CREATE TABLE naijue_erp.import_history_document_manifest (
 batch_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES naijue_erp.import_history_closure_manifest(batch_id),
 document_kind text NOT NULL CHECK(document_kind IN('SALES','TRANSFER')),source_key text NOT NULL CHECK(length(btrim(source_key))>0),
 header_source_row_id uuid NOT NULL, sales_header_id uuid, transfer_header_id uuid,
 header_source_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(header_source_sha256~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 line_count integer NOT NULL CHECK(line_count>0),settlement_count integer NOT NULL CHECK(settlement_count>=0),
 source_document_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(source_document_sha256~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 typed_document_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(typed_document_sha256~'^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 PRIMARY KEY(batch_id,document_kind,source_key),UNIQUE(batch_id,header_source_row_id),UNIQUE(batch_id,sales_header_id),UNIQUE(batch_id,transfer_header_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(batch_id,header_source_row_id) REFERENCES naijue_erp.import_source_row(batch_id,id),
 FOREIGN KEY(batch_id,sales_header_id) REFERENCES naijue_erp.history_sales_header(batch_id,id),
 FOREIGN KEY(batch_id,transfer_header_id) REFERENCES naijue_erp.history_transfer_header(batch_id,id),
 CHECK((document_kind='SALES' AND sales_header_id IS NOT NULL AND transfer_header_id IS NULL)
  OR(document_kind='TRANSFER' AND sales_header_id IS NULL AND transfer_header_id IS NOT NULL AND settlement_count=0))
);
